summary: Enterprise (Hosted): Elevated 5xx in eu-west for pinned model version (rw-chat-12b@2026-01-15) — customer requesting mitigation guidance
description:
Issue summary
- Customer reports increased 5xx responses for Hosted traffic in eu-west when targeting a pinned model version.
- Impact is production-facing (end-user errors) for a single enterprise org. Customer requests immediate mitigation options and an ETA.

Customer impact
- Elevated 5xx on chat completions endpoint in eu-west only.
- Customer states baseline error rate ~<0.2%, currently oscillating 3–8% depending on time of day.
- Customer is pinned to: rw-chat-12b@2026-01-15.

Environment
- Product: Hosted API
- Region: eu-west
- Endpoint: /v1/chat/completions (streaming + non-streaming)
- Auth: org-level API key (enterprise)

Time window
- First observed by customer: 2026-02-18 ~10:05 UTC
- Ticket opened: 2026-02-18 11:10 UTC

Customer-provided examples (sanitized)
- Request IDs (subset): req_9b2f…c11, req_3aa1…8f0, req_10f0…d9a
- Response: HTTP 500/502 with generic upstream error
- Correlation: only when model is pinned; when switching to “latest” (un-pinned) in eu-west, customer reports fewer errors (still some).

Triage checklist (Support)
- [x] Confirm region, model, streaming vs non-streaming
- [x] Capture request IDs and approximate timestamps
- [x] Check status page for eu-west
- [x] Engage SRE/oncall if sustained elevated 5xx and customer impact confirmed

Initial hypothesis
- Possible bad deploy / capacity issue affecting specific model shard set backing pinned version in eu-west; routing for pinned version may be restricting eligible pools.

Escalation
- Escalated to SRE oncall for eu-west elevated 5xx and potential incident declaration.
comments:
2026-02-18 11:12 UTC — Priya Shah (Support)
- Opened ticket from enterprise escalation queue. Confirmed customer pinned model rw-chat-12b@2026-01-15 in eu-west. Asking customer for 10–20 request IDs with timestamps and whether failures are streaming-only.

2026-02-18 11:18 UTC — Customer (via Support email bridge)
- Provided additional request IDs and confirmed both streaming and non-streaming affected. Impacting production traffic. Asked for mitigation steps; open to temporary region shift if needed.

2026-02-18 11:24 UTC — Owen Phillips (Support Eng)
- Checked internal dashboards for eu-west: elevated 5xx across a subset of model backends starting ~10:00 UTC. Appears worse for pinned version traffic. Paging SRE oncall and referencing incident channel.

2026-02-18 11:28 UTC — Rafael Mendes (SRE Oncall)
- Ack. Seeing elevated 5xx for eu-west for a constrained pool. Creating incident: INC-2026-02-18-eu-west-5xx. Request: confirm customer can tolerate temporary failover to eu-central or us-east and/or unpin to latest.

2026-02-18 11:31 UTC — Owen Phillips (Support Eng) — Customer update sent
- Shared: We’re investigating elevated 5xx in eu-west and have engaged oncall. Proposed mitigations:
  1) Temporarily switch region to eu-central or us-east (recommended)
  2) If region change is not possible, temporarily unpin from rw-chat-12b@2026-01-15 to the latest compatible version in eu-west
  3) Add retry with exponential backoff for idempotent requests; for streaming, implement reconnect with last-user message replay (if safe)
- Asked customer to confirm which mitigation they can apply.

2026-02-18 11:48 UTC — Customer
- Confirmed they can route 50% to eu-central and keep 50% in eu-west; will keep model pinned if possible (consistency requirements). Asked whether pinned version can be enabled in eu-central.

2026-02-18 12:03 UTC — Rafael Mendes (SRE Oncall)
- Pinned version is available in eu-central. Recommend full failover for the pinned version until eu-west stabilizes. Root issue: increased error rate on a subset of eu-west workers; pinned routing reducing eligible capacity and increasing churn.

2026-02-18 12:10 UTC — Owen Phillips (Support Eng) — Customer update sent
- Confirmed pinned model rw-chat-12b@2026-01-15 is supported in eu-central.
- Recommended action: route pinned traffic to eu-central for the next 2–4 hours while we mitigate eu-west.
- Provided config guidance (high level): update region setting in their client / base URL routing to eu-central; keep the model string unchanged.

2026-02-18 12:42 UTC — Miles Thornton (SRE)
- Mitigation in progress: draining impacted nodes, rebalancing capacity, and applying a runtime keepalive tweak rollout to eu-west pool. Tracking in incident.

2026-02-18 13:15 UTC — Rafael Mendes (SRE Oncall)
- Error rate trending down after drain/rebalance. Still spiky for pinned traffic; continuing rollout + capacity shift.

2026-02-18 13:28 UTC — Owen Phillips (Support Eng) — Customer update sent
- Shared: mitigation applied (capacity rebalance + draining impacted nodes). eu-west 5xx decreasing; requesting customer keep pinned traffic on eu-central for now; next update in 60 minutes.

2026-02-18 14:40 UTC — Rafael Mendes (SRE Oncall)
- eu-west 5xx back to baseline for 30+ minutes. Monitoring.

2026-02-18 15:05 UTC — Owen Phillips (Support Eng)
- Asked customer to test moving a small portion (10%) back to eu-west with pinned version and report errors. Provided request-id capture instructions if failures recur.

2026-02-18 15:22 UTC — Customer
- Moved 10% back to eu-west; no 5xx observed in last 15 minutes. Will gradually restore.

2026-02-18 16:10 UTC — Rafael Mendes (SRE Oncall)
- Incident moved to monitoring; no further spikes. Will close if stable through peak.

2026-02-19 09:05 UTC — Owen Phillips (Support Eng)
- Customer fully restored to eu-west overnight; reports normal operation. Requested incident summary and whether RCA will be provided.

2026-02-19 09:22 UTC — Owen Phillips (Support Eng) — Customer update sent
- Confirmed stable since mitigation.
- Shared: incident reference INC-2026-02-18-eu-west-5xx (internal). We will provide a brief customer-facing summary once reviewed. No customer action needed now; region failover remains recommended mitigation if similar symptoms recur.

2026-02-20 11:30 UTC — Priya Shah (Support)
- Closing ticket as resolved. Captured learnings for known-issues sprint: pinned model traffic can have reduced routing flexibility during partial pool degradation; ensure support has a standard “region failover + unpin fallback” decision tree and wording.
resolution: Resolved via SRE mitigation in eu-west (drain/rebalance impacted workers + rollout of a small streaming/connection handling improvement) and temporary customer failover of pinned traffic to eu-central. Customer restored traffic to eu-west after stability confirmed; error rate returned to baseline.
internal_notes:
Restricted handling: do not include customer org identifiers in non-restricted channels.
Follow-ups:
- Ensure playbook includes explicit guidance for pinned-model incidents: recommend region failover first; unpin only if region failover not possible.
- Link/update known-issues catalog entry for “Elevated 5xx isolated to a region + pinned model version” (safe-to-share excerpt should focus on mitigations, not internal pool details).
- Related work observed during incident: observability improvements (observability-pack/pr_301) and runtime stability fix (redwood/pr_18742) referenced by SRE.
